card.name: Section names in label cross-references
card.fires_on: The word "and" in "Dosage and Administration", and the end of "PRECAUTIONS", inside bracketed cross-references to other label sections.

modes.label: Dosage and Administration
modes.description: The word "and" between "Dosage" and "Administration" in a bracketed see-section reference.
modes.example: consider a Dasatinib tablet dose reduction [see Dosage<< and>> Administration (2.5) ] .

modes.label: Precautions heading
modes.description: The ending of the word PRECAUTIONS in a cross-reference to that section.
modes.example: the effects of concomitant use with the opioid have been determined (see PRECA<<UTION>>S, Drug Interactions ).
